vigil_assessment.factual_basis: Anthropic acknowledged elevated errors on Claude.ai, the API and Claude Code at 10:53 AM ET on 15 April 2026, deployed an initial fix, later reported Claude.ai and Platform down with Claude Code login unavailable through Claude.ai, and marked the incident resolved at 1:42 PM ET. TechRadar reporters observed failed mobile login, failed Pro verification-code submission, an unused free account shown as prompt-limit exhausted, service-busy errors, a Pro upgrade suggestion and a model-unavailable message whose suggested switch did not restore responses.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The material failure was the conversion of provider-side unavailability into user-facing states that implied exhausted allowance, insufficient plan or unavailable model. Those states direct different remedial actions and economic choices. Access-state integrity requires the system to distinguish account, entitlement, model and service availability so an infrastructure incident cannot masquerade as a reason to authenticate again, switch models or pay for a higher tier.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: This incident demonstrates that continuity, identity and economic controls need one coherent source of service state. Limit enforcement and upgrade prompts should be suppressed or explicitly qualified when provider telemetry indicates an outage; recovery messaging should identify which layer actually failed and avoid asking users to spend money or alter credentials for a provider-side condition.
